title: Guard against dependency not (yet) available during GHA
description:
The call to `pkgload::load_all()` written into the `.Rprofile` crashed my GHA runs in the `setup-renv@v2` and `setup-r-dependencies@v2` steps, respectively. I assume this is because the Rprofile gets loaded for those steps of the Action already, when pkgload is just about to be installed but not available yet. 

https://github.com/r-lib/producethis/blob/5c95e9978abc42bf188d71a42e91e9f741c7cc27/R/prepare_rprofile.R#L9

I wiggled my way around it with a `if ("pkgload" %in% rownames(utils::installed.packages())) { }` in the `.Rprofile`.

title: Should the folder for a report be `target` itself or nested under `target`?
description:
`create_production()` with `type = "report"` fails because [`quarto::quarto_create_project()` here](https://github.com/r-lib/producethis/blob/5c95e9978abc42bf188d71a42e91e9f741c7cc27/R/create.R#L56) needs a `name`. Do we `quarto_create_project()` to create a directory inside of `target` or do we want `quarto_create_project()` to create `target`? 

``` r
library(producethis)
library(fs)

tmp <- dir_create(file_temp())
create_production(tmp, type = "report")
```
